ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with an estimated 20-25% coverage of high-intensity (white) pixels forming a mottled pattern.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Stochastic distribution of small high-intensity white specks across both lobes; larger contiguous white pixel clusters are observed in the lower-medial region of the left lobe and near the lower central junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with an estimated internal angle of 75-85 degrees; vertical depth is approximately 15% of the visible fluke height at the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the continuous trailing edge from notch to tips; characterized by repetitive pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 3-6 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-curving concave trajectory along the trailing edge leading to tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of localized high-intensity circular pixel groups are visible across the left lobe and concentrated near the distal tips, consistent with focal scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, near-vertical high-contrast linear streaks are detectable on the mid-section of the left lobe, disrupting the base dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tips of both lobes, particularly the left, exhibit irregular jagged topography and pixel erosion suggesting cumulative physical wear or minor tissue loss.
